text:
elaine: Heads-up: saw duplicate POSTs when async client timed out and retried. Using httpx AsyncClient timeout=1.2s, our retryer (3 attempts) and X-Idempotency-Key set.

jon: logs?

elaine: snippet:
```
-> POST /v1/orders id=req42
client timeout id=req42 elapsed=1.2s
retry attempt=2 id=req42
-> POST /v1/orders id=req42
201 Created id=ord_900
201 Created id=ord_901
```
Server created two orders.

kevin: likely race from short timeout + tiny backoff jitter. Suggest switch to decorrelated/exponential full-jitter and only auto-replay POSTs if X-Idempotency-Key present (or user opts in). Also cancel in-flight socket on timeout.

elaine: I'll open a PR with: decorrelated jitter impl, new flag `replay_on_timeout` (default false for non-idempotent), optional X-Body-Hash header, and an httpx MockTransport test that simulates delayed success after client timeout.

ci-bot: build #4704 queued -> flaky test rerun scheduled.

jon: please add changelog + docs note about short timeouts causing duplicate creates. We'll audit node/ruby SDKs after merge.

elaine: will do, assigning to eng-sdk.
